spam.instructions: Is this message unsolicited promotional spam in Aosus, an Arabic-only discussion community? Judge its intent, not individual keywords. Understand Arabic dialects, indirect solicitation and obfuscated text.

criteria.true: Unsolicited advertising, investment or IPO promotions, cryptocurrency schemes, guaranteed earnings, vague job recruitment, work-from-home income offers, reward or referral schemes, or invitations to contact someone privately for financial opportunities. Includes indirect and disguised promotion even without links.
criteria.false: Genuine discussion, questions, advice, news, educational content, personal experiences, warnings about scams, or quotations of advertisements without endorsing them. Mentioning finance, jobs, links or usernames alone is not spam.

language_violation.instructions: Does this message violate Aosus's Arabic-only language policy?

criteria.true: The main natural-language content is in English, Chinese, Japanese or another non-Arabic language.
criteria.false: The message is primarily Arabic, including regional dialects and recognizable Arabizi, or contains incidental foreign terminology, code, error messages, URLs, product names or quotations in an Arabic discussion.

spam_category.instructions: What is the primary spam category? Select none when the message is not promotional spam, even if it violates the language policy.

criteria.investment: Investment, trading, IPO subscriptions, crypto or profit schemes.
criteria.employment: Vague employment, remote-work recruitment or easy-income promises.
criteria.referral: Reward apps, surveys, affiliate promotions or referral-based earning schemes.
criteria.advertisement: Other unsolicited commercial advertising or promotional invitations.
